title: Liang Wenfeng Backed Swin Transformer Author: DeepSeek Launches Strategic Layout for Its Embodied AI Brain
source_used: 36Kr (article by QbitAI) relaying a Bloomberg report of 12 Oct 2026
key_facts: According to Bloomberg, DeepSeek plans to lead a seed round of tens of millions of dollars for Winverse AI, at a post-investment valuation of about $400 million (about 2.8 billion yuan).
Meituan-affiliated Longzhu Capital has also made an investment commitment, per the report.

Winverse AI was founded in 2026 by Hu Han, who graduated from Tsinghua in 2008 and led vision-language and embodied-intelligence model research at Tencent Hunyuan; it is in early R&D with no products or technical route disclosed.
Hu Han is a co-author of the Swin Transformer paper, which won the ICCV 2021 Best Paper Award.
It would be DeepSeek's second robotics investment in two months, after about 141 million yuan for 933,400 Unitree Robotics shares in August at 150.80 yuan each, with a 36-month lock-up.
36Kr says DeepSeek has not disclosed any technical cooperation between Winverse and Unitree or any plan to build its own robots; the round is a plan and not yet completed.
quote_evidence: According to Bloomberg, DeepSeek plans to lead its tens of millions of dollars seed round financing.
The post-investment valuation is about 400 million US dollars, equivalent to about 2.8 billion yuan.
Winverse AI was founded in 2026 and is still in the early R&D stage, with no specific products and technical routes publicly disclosed yet.
why_it_matters_hint: DeepSeek is moving from robot bodies (Unitree) to robot brains (Winverse), but the round is a plan reported by one outlet.
